document: Alone Against The Frost Solitaire Adventure in Canadas Wilds (Glenn Rahman  Gavin Inglis) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
Your  first  night  along  the  North  Hanninah  passes  without 
mishap.  You  must  now  decide  whether  to  press  on  hard  to 
penetrate  deep  into  the  region  or  set  a  more  leisurely  pace, 
exploring as you go.
To press on, go to 10. To take your time, go to 11.
